1.

Of all Thou in Thy love dost give, Our God, infinitely good, No greater gift the heavens see Than Christ’s precious blood.

2.

And may the selfsame love us move To trust that blood alone, For without it to seek repose Would then be all in vain.

3.

We therefore would extol Thee For all to us bestowed, For the Saviour, who gave Himself, Thy Son, who is Thy beloved.
